frame_convention: world = unchanged native FEM phantom metres; camera CV +X right +Y down +Z forward
reference_frame: scaled fixture-native coordinates in metres; CAD +X is support normal
limitations: Camera intrinsics, lens distortion and arm-base calibration are estimated, not measured hand-eye calibration.
Fixed distortion is inherited from prior fits; catalog FOV and the 35 mm unspecified mount datum are not hard measurements.
Repeated own-shaft observations share one mount and are correlated.
The physical PSM2 instrument CAD is unavailable; retained needle-driver mesh is a surrogate.
Only one pad perimeter side is visible. Third fixture opening and endoscope optical-to-shaft angle are unmeasured.
Exact RCM port placement is a modeling constraint; CAD rim-depth ambiguity is approximately 3 mm.
